verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents programmatic API key creation and management for distributing or rotating keys (docs-8), and a community user reports per-key expiry and spending limits (comm-12). Those are a limited form of credential scoping suitable for agents. Workspace budgets (docs-10) cap spend at the workspace level, not per credential. missing for 10: documented permission scopes restricting what a key can access (models, endpoints, providers), first-party docs on per-key limits and expiry, explicit least-privilege or agent-credential guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: OpenRouter provides endpoints to programmatically manage your API keys, enabling key creation and management for applications that need to distribute or rotate keys automatically.
One thing that OpenRouter makes easy is the ability to manage API keys (mint new ones, expiry/limits per key, etc.)
